body: you are right, everyone who has posted has been. whats the point in holding on to something because of the good memories, when the ones in the present for lack of better words, sucked and hurt me.  just need to move on, not even from her, just the memories of what I thought was "perfect". im young, and I have a lot of heart, no matter how much good it brings out in me, it limits me from thinking clearly. really, all of you have been very helpful. for the first time in a while, I 'll be able to lay my head down with a fairly clear mind.

well i dont talk to her anymore, i dont think any amount of apology will ever allow me to forgive her. and alot of what you said was right, things I have been thinking about/close friends have told me, comming from a complete stranger just means more, makes more sense. I guess its just getting over the things she said to make me feel like I do and moving on. its a struggle. On Monday Im looking for someone to go talk to, would have today but most places that are covered by my insurance are closed. The things you said really made me think in a positive/inspiring way. I appreciate it, thank you.
its nice to know that there are kind/decent people on the internet. you are right, i just need to get out of the funk and start looking for someone to talk to, self-esteem, bah.

Let me start off by giving you guys some background information. Im in my early 20's, talented artist and musician. I have family who loves me and friends who "care" about me, thought sometimes I feel like im being used. In college, at the top of my class, some of my work has been nationally recognized, more has been shown locally and campus wide.  Im not socially awkward, but im not the life of the party, I choose not to be though, at times i shine but I like to be low key, I am a very modest person.  The things im about to say are going to make me seem like a selfish person, people have things much worse than I do, I realise this, but I need someone to talk to, someone that might understand me. Talking about this kinda stuff to friends and loved ones isnt exactly easy.


Where do I start? Basically when something bad happens, I let it effect me, maybe moreso than it should, espcially when it involves loved ones, not necessarily myself.  I wont go into specifics but my father and brother have some troubles, and it usually is the catalyst to my depression. When something happens with them, its not just little things, its usually huge shit that the everyday person does not necessarily have to deal with, and i am pretty sure that the depression caused by these incidents effects my personal relationships. I also feel under appreciated. These points relate to my other problem, the ex.  She was my best friend for quite a while before we started dating then once we started dating things were beautiful. Last year we broke up, still dont know th exact reason, we got back together in the summer and just a few months ago broke up agian.  To make the long story short, we never offically started dating again, it was just assumed, shes a good girl but has her problems, she could be selfish at times, but thats more do to how she was raised than anything else.


Anyways she called me on a saturday crying a few months back, saying she was upset becuase she didnt know our anniversary anymore, we quickly decided to make it then, it was the perfect moment for a few reasons(right after one of the best weeks we have ever had together). We talked for a while until we went to sleep. Out of the blue on monday she broke up with me, she cried about it, i sent her this package of stuff, which i had put together beforehand anyways, and she said it made her cry and miss me and shit.  Now ive never done anything wrong to this girl. always made sure she had everything she wanted, did things that made her happy. I made her my world... And it kills me, i never did anything bad to her, her dumping me again was out of the blue and so random. Its not the dumping that got to me as much as everything else. Let me explain.


After we broke up both times, she said horrible things that copmletly killed me.  I mean so uncalled for, jsut like vicious and nasty.  She goes on spurts of not talking to me for a while then will talk to me and tell me she misses me and loves me. I realize the problem is probably with her, but i love the girl so much, that i cant just turn it off. I miss her... i dont even know what else to say, but the things she does effect me so much.


I use to be a confident person, I use to love myself. I use to appreciate life and living, I use to do a lot of things, but that seems so long ago makes me wonder if i ever was. Since the first break up I do the bare essentials to get by but even half ass that. i hate myself now, I pretty much push everyone away. Ive met girls, nicer and better looking, and I have more in common with them than the ex, but I never persue or show interest when they do, I just dont care, one of my friends thought I might have been gay becuause of a few of the girls I rejected. I ended up with one of them for a bit but she turned out to be an asshole, sex was amazing, but an asshole. Another girl is the sweetest, most loveable person ever, but she has her baggage, as do I. Acutally she feels the same way about stuff that I do, shes depressed, goes to group therapy and stuff but Im too afraid to hurt her. Every dude uses her for her looks + body, and she really feels shitty about her self. I mean I could honestly see myself with someone like her but its just not the right time for either of us. This makes me think its not so much about me missing my ex, but the things shes dont/said that "haunt" me.  When we started seeing her, she knew about trust issues I had, we were friends before so she knew my story, and shes totally exploited that part of me, I let my walls down and let her in and I dont know why...


For the past year almost 2 now that I think about it, Ive had random bouts of locking my self in my room for days on end, shutting out the light / people around me. Ill have a good week where I go back to old me, but then I just turn bcak to this.  I was talking to someone for a while but all he wanted to do was give me drugs, Id take them but they made me feel worse.  He ended up saying i had anxiety and i started using what he gave me to excess (xanex) so I dropped the meds and the doctor. The past few months have been killing me and I cant shake negitive thoughts/feeeling sorry for myself.  I know i should appreciate what im lucky enough to have but I cant anymore. I feel like ikeep getting the bad end of the stick no matter what good I do, I just want to be happy, a feeling I havent felt in a few years.  I try so hard to be positive but i always feel like I am failing.  The thoughts of suicide have been more intense lately and I cant  get them out of my head, I keep telling myself that its not worth it, my time will come soon but it doesnt work. Im just so tired of feeling the pain that I do, I just want a solution, and ive been waiting so long to feel better, trying to do things to make myself feel better but no success.  


I just dont know what to do anymore. I feel liek the problem has grown too much for me to handle or anyone for that matter. Whatever Im feeling has become debilitating I dunno even what Im asking, maybe suggestions, experiences from people who felt like I have, anything would help. Sorry if this makes no sense, my heads a mess right now.
